New Customer Prequalification Process - Version 1
The prequalification flow determines channel, runs path-specific early checks, and branches to pass, notice, manual review, or evidence request. A pass reaches line assignment and offer display. Customer acceptance continues the application to full underwriting; it is not final approval.
Decision paths:
- Receive Application -> Determine Channel
- Determine Channel -> Run Prequalification Checks
- Run Prequalification Checks -> Rule Result
- Rule Result --Pass--> Assign Preliminary Line
- Rule Result --RFAI--> Evidence Request
- Rule Result --Manual Review--> Manual Review
- Evidence Request --resolved--> Run Prequalification Checks
- Assign Preliminary Line --customer accepts--> Continue to Full Underwriting
- NOAA -> Assign Applicable NOAA -> Send Notification -> Expire Application
10:
New Customer Full Underwriting Process - Version 1
Full underwriting refreshes policy and credit checks, scoring, affordability, fraud, and compliance. Resolved NMI evidence must pass the new evidence-integrity gate before policy and credit checks rerun. Code 120 exception approval only clears that rule; Ready to Fund still requires all remaining controls and verifications.
Decision paths:
- Continue Application from Prequalification -> Run Full Underwriting Policy and Credit Checks
- Full Underwriting Checks -> Rule Result
- Rule Result --Pass--> Run Scoring and Affordability
- Scoring and Affordability -> Fraud and Compliance Checks
- Fraud and Compliance --Clear--> Final Verifications
- Final Verifications --Complete--> Ready to Fund
- Rule Result --RFAI--> Evidence or NMI
- Evidence or NMI --resolved--> Evidence Integrity Gate
- Evidence Integrity Gate --valid--> Run Full Underwriting Policy and Credit Checks
- Evidence Integrity Gate --invalid--> Manual Review
- Fraud and Compliance --not clear--> Manual Review
- Manual Review may approve, counter, request more information, or decline under documented authority
